name: r60_ci_label
title: CI job label honesty (no baked pin counts)
intro: R60 (2026-10-16): the R59 gate job label said '913 pins' while the measured gate was 932 -- a count copied into an artifact goes stale the moment the tree moves (the 69/68 disease class). The label is now count-free (the measured count lives in the run output: 'Ran N tests ... OK') and a permanent pin keeps any count from creeping back into it. Tiny round, one fix, one pin file.
markers: name: Full test gate (count lives in the run output)
the baked pin count is gone from the gate job label
the gate still runs the safe discovery mode
regenerated manual keeps its generated appendix
commit_message: R60: CI job label honesty - no baked pin counts (count lives in the run output)
